description: A valid scorecard receipt carries the Human Director's authority for learning promotion (SN-0340). The verifier accepts a personal grant OR a receipt meeting this schema plus the mechanical five-step validation. Fail-closed: no valid receipt, no promotion.

decided_by.description: Named scorer. Anonymous receipts are not authority.

promotion_option_id.description: The enumerated option id whose selection authorizes promotion. Winner must equal this.

scope_target.description: Must exactly match the promotion target block id.

scores.description: Keyed by option id. Every option scored on all four dimensions, 0-10.

step3_gate.description: Hard stops. No score overrides a failed gate.

falsifier.description: Concrete evidence that would prove the decision wrong.

receipt_posted_comment_id.description: GitHub comment id where the receipt was posted. A private scorecard is not a gate.

title: Scorecard Receipt Authority — learning promotion
